# Commit Message Skill

Use this skill to produce commit messages in Conventional Commit format.

## Format

`type(scope): subject`

## Common Types

- feat
- fix
- docs
- refactor
- test
- chore
- ci

Include `!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` for breaking changes.
